title: Sign in and sign up
body: A person signs in with an email and a password. ^sign-in
A wrong password shows an error under the field; the email stays filled in. ^wrong-password
Sign up: name, email, a password of at least 8 characters; a 6-digit code arrives by email and the account is created once the code is entered; the code can be sent again after 60 seconds. ^sign-up
The server keeps the password only as a hash. ^password-hash
